title: I made MUZE, a museum builder where your own pictures hang on the walls (free, Windows, early access)
author: Expert-Kitchen8064
selftext:
I just put up an early-access Windows build of a project called MUZE.

You drop in your own pictures (or anyone's), up to 800, and it builds out museum rooms you can walk through. Press Tab for a build menu to move, place, and add items. There are a few pre-made room layouts with decorations, and you can play your own music while you explore.

How AI fit in: I used AI to help with the code for the Vulkan gallery app and some of the visual assets, then spent my time on the room generation, picture hanging, and the build menu. The itch page lists it as AI Assisted for Code and Graphics.

Free / pay-what-you-want on itch: [https://doomed316.itch.io/muze-make-your-own-art-exhibit](https://doomed316.itch.io/muze-make-your-own-art-exhibit)

It's still early, so expect quirks. If you try it, I'd love to know whether the museum feels worth walking once your own photos are on the walls.
